summary.text: The test paid bob from alice and expected every payment to stay at zero or above.
The ledger saw a payment of minus 1 after the first step and the check failed.
The model has no description, so its purpose is not written down.

hypotheses.claim: The test's adapter (its code that talks to the system) probably sends a negative amount, so the test is at fault.
next_steps: Rerun the test with the adapter's negative flag switched off.
Ask the test author why the adapter flips the sign.

hypotheses.claim: The system probably accepts a negative payment that it should refuse, so the system is at fault.
next_steps: Send a payment of minus 1 by hand and see whether the system refuses it.

hypotheses.claim: The test's payment generator probably makes amounts the model does not expect, so the test is at fault.
next_steps: Read the amounts the generator makes for the first three payments.

talking_points.text: A payment check failed on the first step of the run.
The failing step paid a negative amount.
